title: Роща светлячков
prompt:
Revise this original fantasy elf HUD asset sheet. Keep the exact 1536×1024 canvas, 3 equal columns × 2 equal rows and same asset positions. Make six clearly separable front-on art assets with true transparent alpha and ample cell padding, no built-in labels or numbers. Preserve the distinct palette, placement, overall frame and button dimensions, open round shape of the energy reservoir, low-contrast dark centers of panel and button, and winged fairy + simple garden bud silhouettes. Change the actual physical material of every frame, rim, button trim and corner to the material specified below. Metallic gold/silver rims, bevels, rivets, nailheads, clasps, gemstones, metallic lines or paint must disappear entirely. Colors may remain as biological or natural slate hues and restrained lighting. Top left: flat almost square dark HUD plate, intentionally sparse and quiet inside, decoration stays along outer border and corners only. Top middle: a genuinely circular empty reservoir frame with a physically open circular hole (fully transparent) about 72% of the outer diameter for game liquid. Keep interior entirely empty including lower section so engine can fill it dynamically, no painted level or central ornament. Top right: one horizontal 3:1 quiet dark button. Bottom left: one isolated bright readable fairy icon, two primary wings. Bottom middle: one isolated garden bud with two leaves. Bottom right: one isolated L-shaped top-left matching corner. Exact positions. Material must read at HUD sizes; limited shiny specular highlights, controlled high-contrast silhouette. Hand painted fantasy interface, no background scene.
Warm firefly grove. Make the panel and rim out of actual stripped bark with wide visible rough wood grains and overlapping nonparallel twisted tree roots. Roots follow the sides but flex and organically vary in thickness and cross at the corners; keep it conservative around text. A few young lime-green leaves and branching vine tendrils grow directly out of the wood. Rounded reservoir is circular inside and bent woody vine outside, two small leaves arranged winglike at 12 o'clock. Button is dark bark slab with carved-overgrown roots no smooth rim. L corner out of two visible connected thick split branches with ivy. Rich umber, pine black, moss-greens and pale chartreuse. Amber is only warm bark light and the bud, no bronze casing. Fairy and golden-brown bud still recognizable.
